title: The north rises. Perhaps this was what the Pope had counted on. On New Year's Day 1405 the Portuguese lands proclaim a Kingdom of Estremadura and La Mancha and the Madrid country rise again as a Kingdom of Toledo; the next day the Leonese of Shalamanka rise against their Naṣrid ṭāʾifa as Ciudad Rodrigo. Forty-eight towns of the crown and sixteen of Shalamanka go over; Toledo, Lisbon and Setúbal hold
